spans.s:
प्लु {c1c} A. (प्लवते, प्लुत)
1 To float,
swim; किं नामैतत् मज्जंत्यलाबूनि
ग्रावाणः प्लवंत इति

; प्लवंते धर्मलघवो
लोकेंऽभसि यथा प्लवाः Subhāṣ.
--2 To
cross in a boat.
--3 To swing to and
fro, vibrate.
--4 To leap, jump,
spring;

; 14. 13, 15. 46.
--5 To plunge into, bathe.
--6 To
fly or haste away.
--7 To blow (as
the wind).
--8 To fade away,
disappear.
--9 To soar, hover about.
--10
To skip.
--11 To be prolated or
lengthened (as a vowel). --Caus. (
प्लावयति-ते)
1 To cause to swim or float.
--2
To remove, wash away.
--3 To bathe.
--4 To inundate, deluge, flood,
submerge; यैः प्लावयिष्यंति समंततोऽमी
Śi. 3. 74, 7. 74.
--5 To cause to reel
or fluctuate.
--6 To lengthen,
prolate (a vowel.). --WITH अभि
1 to
overflow.
--2 to overwhelm, overcome.

प्लुत p. p. [प्लु-क्त]
1 Swimming,
floating.
--2 Inundated, submerged,
overflowed.
--3 Leaped, jumped.
--4 Lengthened, protracted or
prolated (as a vowel).
--5 Covered
with, filled with.
--6 Bathed in.
(See प्लु).
--तं
1 A jump, leap,
spring.
--2 Capering, one of the
paces of a horse.
--3 Bounding,
vaulting.
--Comp.
--गतिः a hare.
(--f.) {1} going by leaps. {2} a
gallop, bounding motion.

प्लुतिः f. [प्लु-भावे क्तिन्]
1 A flood,
overflowing, inundation.
--2 A leap,
jump, spring: as in मंडूकप्लुति.
--3
Capering, one of the paces of a
horse.
--4 Prolation or protraction
of a vowel.

प्लुष् {vI.v} {c1c} {c4c} {c9c} P. (प्लोषति, प्लुष्यति,
प्लुष्णाति, प्लुष्ट) To burn, scorch, singe,
sear,

. {vII.v}
{c9c} P. (प्लुष्णाति)
1 To sprinkle, wet.
--2
To anoint.
--3 To fill.

प्लुस् {c4c} P. (प्लुस्यति)
1 To burn.
--2
To share.

1 Fire.
--2 The burning of
a house.
--3 Oil.
प्लुष्ट p. p. Scorched, burnt, singed.
